name: ChapterEvents - Recent Past Events
description: The past variant of the events section, capped at the most recent few. A chapter between events used to render as a blank page, which reads as abandoned rather than quiet — showing what it recently did is the cheapest proof it is running. Same component and the same cards as the upcoming list; only the heading and the card variant differ, which is why it is a variant rather than a second component and why capturing it matters: nothing else would catch the two drifting apart.
